article_summaries.title: Free Realms Celebrates its 12 Millionth Registered User
article_summaries.summary: A Ten Ton Hammer news post reporting that Free Realms passed 12 million registered users shortly after its virtual Summer Camp release on June 7, 2010. Events were planned to celebrate the milestone and the upcoming Fourth of July holiday. The article gives no details of those events or of the Summer Camp content.
